items.source: By default, methods inherited from CrudRepository inherit the transactional configuration from SimpleJpaRepository. For read operations, the transaction configuration readOnly flag is set to true. All others are configured with a plain @Transactional so that default transaction configuration applies. Repository methods that are backed by transactional repository fragments inherit the transactional attributes from the actual fragment method.
items.translation: 默认情况下，从CrudRepository继承的方法会从SimpleJpaRepository继承事务配置。 对于读取操作，事务配置的readOnly标志被设置为true。 其余方法均配置为普通的@Transactional，以便应用默认的事务配置。 由事务性存储库片段支持的方法将从实际的片段方法继承事务属性。

items.source: Typically, you want the readOnly flag to be set to true, as most of the query methods only read data. In contrast to that, deleteInactiveUsers() makes use of the @Modifying annotation and overrides the transaction configuration. Thus, the method runs with the readOnly flag set to false.
items.translation: 通常，您希望将 `readOnly` 标志设置为 `true`，因为大多数查询方法仅用于读取数据。相比之下，`deleteInactiveUsers()` 使用了 `@Modifying` 注解并覆盖了事务配置，因此该方法以 `readOnly` 标志设置为 `false` 的方式运行。

items.source: You can use transactions for read-only queries and mark them as such by setting the readOnly flag. Doing so does not, however, act as a check that you do not trigger a manipulating query (although some databases reject INSERT and UPDATE statements inside a read-only transaction). The readOnly flag is instead propagated as a hint to the underlying JDBC driver for performance optimizations. Furthermore, Spring performs some optimizations on the underlying JPA provider. For example, when used with Hibernate, the flush mode is set to MANUAL when you configure a transaction as readOnly, which causes Hibernate to skip dirty checks (a noticeable improvement on large object trees).
items.translation: 您可以使用事务执行只读查询，并通过设置 `readOnly` 标志来标记此类事务。然而，这样做并不能作为防止触发修改性查询的检查（尽管某些数据库会拒绝在只读事务中执行 `INSERT` 和 `UPDATE` 语句）。`readOnly` 标志实际上是作为提示传递给底层 JDBC 驱动程序，以进行性能优化。此外，Spring 还会对底层的 JPA 提供者执行一些优化。例如，当与 Hibernate 配合使用时，如果将事务配置为只读，则刷新模式会被设置为 `MANUAL`，这将导致 Hibernate 跳过脏检查（在大型对象树中可带来显著的性能提升）。

items.source: This example causes call to addRoleToAllUsers(…) to run inside a transaction (participating in an existing one or creating a new one if none are already running). The transaction configuration at the repositories is then neglected, as the outer transaction configuration determines the actual one used. Note that you must activate <tx:annotation-driven /> or use @EnableTransactionManagement explicitly to get annotation-based configuration of facades to work. This example assumes you use component scanning.
items.translation: 此示例会导致对 `addRoleToAllUsers(…)` 的调用在事务内执行（参与已存在的事务，或在没有运行中的事务时创建新事务）。此时，仓库层的事务配置将被忽略，因为外层事务配置决定了实际使用的事务。请注意，要使基于注解的 facade 配置生效，必须激活 `<tx:annotation-driven />` 或显式使用 `@EnableTransactionManagement`。 此示例假设您使用了组件扫描。

items.source: Doing so causes the findAll() method to run with a timeout of 10 seconds and without the readOnly flag.
items.translation: 这样会导致 `findAll()` 方法在 10 秒超时限制下运行，且不设置 `readOnly` 标志。

items.source: Note that the call to save is not strictly necessary from a JPA point of view, but should still be there in order to stay consistent to the repository abstraction offered by Spring Data.
items.translation: 请注意，从 JPA 的角度来看，调用save并非绝对必要，但为了与 Spring Data 提供的仓库抽象保持一致，该调用仍应保留。

items.source: While examples discuss @Transactional usage on the repository, we generally recommend declaring transaction boundaries when starting a unit of work to ensure proper consistency and desired transaction participation.
items.translation: 虽然示例中讨论了在仓库层使用 `@Transactional`，但我们通常建议在启动工作单元时声明事务边界，以确保正确的数据一致性和所需的事务参与。
